name: TableGrid
description: A CSS Grid-based table layout for complex data display. Uses CSS grid-template-columns for flexible column sizing. Includes TableGridHeader and TableGridCell sub-components.

notes: The root element uses role='grid' to communicate grid semantics to assistive technologies.
TableGridHeader cells use role='columnheader' for proper header identification.
TableGridCell elements use role='gridcell' for proper cell identification.
Ensure logical reading order matches visual grid order.

columns.description: REQUIRED. CSS grid-template-columns value, e.g. '1fr 2fr 1fr' or 'repeat(3, 1fr)'.

children.description: Grid content — use TableGridHeader and TableGridCell sub-components.

className.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element.

subcomponents.TableGridHeader: Renders a column header cell within the grid layout.
subcomponents.TableGridCell: Renders a data cell within the grid layout.

do: Use CSS grid-template-columns syntax for the columns prop.
Use TableGridHeader for all header cells and TableGridCell for data cells.
Use for complex layouts where traditional table elements are limiting.
dont: Do not use TableGrid for simple tabular data — use Table or TableSemantic instead.
Do not mix TableGridHeader and TableGridCell out of order.
Do not use pixel values directly in the columns prop — prefer fr units or token-based values.
